Summary:

x86 has issues. It's extremely closed, to the point where you can't trust the CPU to not have backdoors and rat out your secrets.

There are alternatives, e.g. the popular ARM, but it's not build for high end desktop use.
One good alternative is the POWER architecture, which is open so that it can be verified to not do anything malicious.
It's also quite POWERful. No seriously, it's on par to x86 and superior in some cases.
Unfortunately they only sell high end servers with it.

This guy presents their "Talos" open motherboards which work with POWER CPUs.
Downside is that you won't be using new NVidia cards with that, but the system is not gonna be a gaming rig anyway.

Takeaway: maybe in the future we'll have a seriously viable option to switch away from x86. Today that option is available for die hard early adopters, but those are needed to finance the future.
